description: This file is a Perl module implementing an interface to the Git version control system, defining the Git class with methods to execute Git commands, manage repositories, and handle credentials, pipes, and configuration.

classes.name: Git
classes.description: Main class providing an interface to Git commands and repository management.

classes.name: Git::Error::Command
classes.description: Exception class representing errors from external Git commands.

methods.name: repository
methods.description: Constructs a new Git repository object, determining repository and working copy paths.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Executes a Git command, returning output as string or array.

methods.name: command_oneline
methods.description: Executes a Git command and returns its first line of output.

methods.name: command_output_pipe
methods.description: Runs a command and returns a pipe to its output.

methods.name: command_input_pipe
methods.description: Runs a command and returns a pipe to send input to it.

methods.name: command_close_pipe
methods.description: Closes a pipe from command_output_pipe or command_input_pipe, checking success.

methods.name: command_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Runs a command with bidirectional pipes, returning process ID and pipes.

methods.name: command_close_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Closes bidirectional pipes, checking for command success.

methods.name: command_noisy
methods.description: Executes a command without capturing output; output goes to terminal.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the Git version string.

methods.name: exec_path
methods.description: Returns path to Git's exec directory.

methods.name: html_path
methods.description: Returns path to Git's HTML documentation.

methods.name: get_tz_offset
methods.description: Returns local timezone offset from GMT.

methods.name: get_record
methods.description: Reads a record from a filehandle using a specified separator.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Prompts the user for input or password, reading from environment variables or terminal.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Returns the repository directory for the instance.

methods.name: wc_path
methods.description: Returns the working copy path.

methods.name: wc_subdir
methods.description: Returns the subdirectory inside the working copy.

methods.name: wc_chdir
methods.description: Changes the internal working subdirectory.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration variable.

methods.name: config_bool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean configuration variable.

methods.name: config_path
methods.description: Retrieves a path configuration variable.

methods.name: config_int
methods.description: Retrieves an integer configuration variable.

methods.name: config_regexp
methods.description: Retrieves config keys matching a regex.

methods.name: get_colorbool
methods.description: Determines if color should be used for specified operation.

methods.name: get_color
methods.description: Retrieves color sequence for a specified slot.

methods.name: remote_refs
methods.description: Fetches references from a remote repository.

methods.name: ident
methods.description: Retrieves author or committer ident info.

methods.name: ident_person
methods.description: Parses ident string to get name and email.

methods.name: hash_object
methods.description: Calculates SHA1 hash of a file considering type.

methods.name: hash_and_insert_object
methods.description: Hashes a file and adds it to the object database.

methods.name: cat_blob
methods.description: Outputs blob content identified by SHA1.

methods.name: port_num
methods.description: Converts port name or number to numeric port number.

methods.name: credential_read
methods.description: Reads credential key-value pairs from a filehandle.

methods.name: credential_write
methods.description: Writes credential key-value pairs to a filehandle.

methods.name: credential
methods.description: Runs 'git credential' commands with credentials.

methods.name: temp_acquire
methods.description: Creates and locks a temporary file for a given name.

methods.name: temp_is_locked
methods.description: Checks if a temp file is locked.

methods.name: temp_release
methods.description: Releases a lock on a temporary file.

methods.name: temp_reset
methods.description: Resets (truncates and seeks) a temp file handle.

methods.name: temp_path
methods.description: Returns filename of temp file.

methods.name: unquote_path
methods.description: Unescapes C-style escaped paths.

methods.name: get_comment_line_char
methods.description: Retrieves core.commentchar setting for comment lines.

methods.name: comment_lines
methods.description: Prefixes lines with comment character.
